in_sanskrit.name: Gayansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledge, Wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gayansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gayas means 'cow' and Ish means 'god'. This name signifies the god who imparts knowledge, hence the name Gayansh. It is also associated with the sage Gayasri, who is believed to bestow wisdom upon his devotees.

in_hindi.name: गायंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who brings joy and knowledge with them.

in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the lord of knowledge and the deity of wisdom.

This name signifies the god who imparts knowledge, hence the name Gayansh. It is also associated with the sage Gayasri, who is believed to bestow wisdom upon his devotees.
